newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona air cargo traffic down 9.1 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona air cargo traffic down 9.1 pct in July.

text.p: Cargo volume at Barcelona airport fell 9.1 percent in July to 6,464 tonnes, the airport authority said.
The accumulated cargo volume so far this year now stands at 48,137 tonnes, 7.6 percent more than the first seven months of 1996.

Non-European Union international freight performed best with a fall of only 0.9 percent to 974 tonnes in the month. The volume of domestic cargo fell 10.9 percent to 2,526 tonnes while European Union cargo, which showed double digit growth in the early months of this year, fell 10.0 percent to 2,964 tonnes.

Passenger numbers, excluding transit passengers, rose 13.2 percent to 1.39 million in the month, taking the year-to-date total to 8.31 million, up 13.8 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
